title: Where To Watch Fourth Of July Fireworks Around Santa Clarita In 2026 - NewsBreak
text:
By Steven Barrera ,
7 hours ago
Santa Clarita Valley residents looking to celebrate Independence Day with fireworks will have several options this Fourth of July weekend. Whether families are searching for thrill rides, community gatherings, or a classic Santa Clarita ending to the holiday, multiple fireworks displays are scheduled across the valley.
One of the biggest celebrations returns to Six Flags Magic Mountain with Star-Spangled Nights presented by M&M’S, taking place July 3 through July 5.
The three-night event combines roller coasters and patriotic entertainment before ending each evening with a fireworks spectacular lighting up the sky above the park.
Guests can spend the day enjoying attractions before gathering for the nighttime celebration featuring music and themed entertainment.
According to Six Flags, fireworks and entertainment schedules are weather permitting and subject to change, and select rides may close early to prepare for the show.
Fireworks will take place all three nights, giving visitors more than one opportunity to celebrate.
For those looking for a free local option, the Stevenson Ranch Fourth of July Fireworks Show returns to Dr. Richard Rioux Memorial Park, located at 26233 Faulkner Drive in Stevenson Ranch.
The annual community celebration is scheduled to begin at 9 p.m. and remains a popular gathering spot for families wanting to stay close to home while enjoying a traditional fireworks display.
Another longtime local favorite is the City of Santa Clarita Fourth of July Fireworks Show at Valencia Town Center.
The annual event is scheduled to begin at approximately 9:15 p.m., giving residents a chance to close out Independence Day with one of the valley’s signature celebrations.
Spectators can watch the fireworks from around the Valencia Town Center area while listening to the synchronized soundtrack broadcast live on KHTS AM 1220 and 98.1 FM.
With multiple shows taking place across the Santa Clarita Valley, residents are encouraged to arrive early, expect traffic and check event organizers for any weather-related updates before heading out.
